dedupe_keys.name: ab617 path to clean air ferry routes

description: The Bay Area Air Quality Management District provides commuter ferry routes within the AB617 Path to Clean Air emissions-inventory area through the Metropolitan Transportation Commission catalogue. The provider states that the routes were determined from San Francisco Bay Area Water Emergency Transportation Authority information. The native table metadata exposes multiline geometry and no additional route attributes. This geometry can support spatial route representation for transport and emissions studies, but the listing does not establish schedules, passenger demand, vessel characteristics or route capacity. Access is through the public Socrata table and its API metadata. A licence and update frequency are not stated in the inspected listing. The data-update timestamp is July 2022, and current route operation has not been verified. The related East Oakland ferry-route resource describes a different AB617 inventory area and names the Harbor Bay route. Geometric overlap between the two resources remains untested.
